summary: End-to-end frontend testing of the Vendor Management app across /login, /vendor, /bill, /reports. Verified top colored action bar contains all 7 workflow buttons (New, Save, Edit, Submit, Final Approval, Export JSON/Excel, Print) plus Search, Change Logo, and page-nav on every page. Verified logo file input exists, export dropdown reveals JSON/Excel entries, and that btn-workflow-action is absent from the DOM. Executed full vendor approval flow -> permanent Vendor Code generated (matches ^AE\d{4}JV\d{4}$) and shown in green approval-banner + field-vendorCode. Executed full 5-step Bill Processing flow with vendor snapshot autofill and payment calculations (GST 1800, Gross 11800, TDS 200, Net 11600). Approved bill appears in Reports due-table and sum-count reflects 1. Payment Voucher: generate -> submit -> approve status transitions all worked. 53/53 assertions PASSED.

issues: Export dropdown menu (JSON/Excel) can overlap with the toast/user chip due to header wrapping on 1920px viewport; not blocking but slightly awkward visually.

critical_code_review_comments: BillProcessing.jsx line 5 & 166: multiple statements on one line (import + Header import, and JSX return chained to variable assignment). Works but hurts readability - consider splitting.
store.js uses localStorage inside module top-level (getLogo try/catch OK); nextTempRef relies on Math.random with only 8 hex chars — potential collision risk for high volume, minor.
TopActionBar disables submit/approve via `disabled` prop but Vendor page still calls handleApprove with an error toast on wrong step (defensive - fine).
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_FIRM_ACME vendor -> approved (AE0001JV2627) and one bill BILL/2627/0001 with net 11600 + PV/2627/0001 (Approved). Data persists in localStorage; can be cleared via localStorage.clear().
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 workflow buttons are now inside TopActionBar. Vendor form only requires firmName + mobileNo. Step transitions require the role name (checkedByName, approvedByName, siteInchargeName, purchaseInchargeName, accountInchargeName, approverName). Vendor code matches ^AE\d{4}JV\d{4}$. Bill approval banner shows refNo like BILL/{FY}/{serial} and Net Payable. Reports page shows due-row-{refNo} rows and PV flow uses pv-bill-select/pv-generate/pv-no/pv-status.
